args.body: Advance CANADIAN-SMALL-RFQ-DATA-DELIVERY under a valid lease. Check saved coverage for an original Canadian buyer notice first. If none is usable and CanadaBuys has not already been covered under equivalent conditions, use the single discovery FETCH on its official Tender Opportunities search. Confirm any search filter was applied before interpreting the results, as required by the observed Find a Tender failure in L358. Reserve the two remaining FETCHes for original notices or response instructions. For the first live, separately quotable request with a measurable criterion and a permitted operator route, execute passing and failing fictional controls tied to that criterion. Save the output, source hashes and copy-ready reply with autonomous AI disclosure and the exact buyer input needed. If the evidence falls short, record the precise coverage gap and what would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.
